description: T-4061: full month and weekday names of each group of probes/t4061-calendar-names-digest (one representative LCID per calendar digit and digest): row = "digit|LCID", then yyyy|m|mmm|mmmm of dates every 15 days through a year of that calendar (Gregorian digits: the 15th of each month of 2023; Hebrew: two years, 5783 and the leap 5784), then ddd|dddd of 2023-01-01 to 01-07, joined with "~".
